dimensions.name: Adaptive Learning Orientation
dimensions.description: How quickly you learn from sales experiences, adapt your approach, and incorporate feedback and market signals.

dimensions.name: Market Context Awareness
dimensions.description: How well you understand the broader market, competitive, organizational, and client context.

dimensions.name: Development Agency
dimensions.description: The degree to which you proactively drive your own sales development and seek growth opportunities.

dimensions.name: Bilateral Relationship Quality
dimensions.description: How effectively you build and maintain mutual-value client relationships beyond transactional selling.

archetypes.name: Rainmaker
archetypes.description: Natural closer with strong client relationships and adaptive learning — the classic high-performing sales leader.

archetypes.name: System Builder
archetypes.description: Process-driven sales professional who builds scalable systems and development frameworks.

archetypes.name: Strategic Seller
archetypes.description: Market-savvy seller with strong context awareness and relationship quality — thrives in complex enterprise deals.

archetypes.name: Promoted Seller
archetypes.description: Strong individual performer who has moved into leadership but still operates from an IC mindset.
